entries.title: Jonah 2:1
segments: And Jonah prayed to the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,

entries.title: Jonah 2:2
segments: and he said, I cried to the LORD from my distress. And He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried for help, [and] You heard my voice.

entries.title: Jonah 2:3
segments: For You cast me [into the] depths of the seas, and the current surrounded me. All Your breakers and Your waves passed over me.

entries.title: Jonah 2:4
segments: Then I said, I am cast off from Your eyes, yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.

entries.title: Jonah 2:5
segments: Waters encompassed me, [even] to the soul; the depth closed around me; the seaweed was bound to my head.

entries.title: Jonah 2:6
segments: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was around me forever; yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O LORD my God.

entries.title: Jonah 2:7
segments: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; and my prayer came in to You, into Your holy temple.

entries.title: Jonah 2:8
segments: They who take heed to lying vanities forsake their kindness;

entries.title: Jonah 2:9
segments: but I will sacrifice to You with the voice of thanksgiving; I will fulfill that which I have vowed. Salvation [belongs] to the LORD!

entries.title: Jonah 2:10
segments: And the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out on the dry land.
